items.title: Google and Oracle deals support long-term US plant operations
items.summary: Google and Constellation Energy have announced a long-term collaboration to bring 890 MW of new nuclear capacity onto the PJM Interconnection grid, as well as a power purchase agreement. Meanwhile, Oracle is to subscribe to output from the Point Beach nuclear power plant.

items.title: Concreting milestones at Chinese Hualong One units
items.summary: The concreting of the inner containment dome has been completed at unit 3 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, while concrete pours have also been completed at units 1 and 2 of the Zhaoyuan plant in Shandong province.

items.title: DOE offers Vistra loan for reactor upgrades and uprates
items.summary: The US Department of Energy has announced a conditional loan commitment of up to USD4.2 billion to finance uprates and modernisation projects at Vistra Corp's Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry nuclear power plants.

items.title: Europe delivers final ITER vacuum vessel sector
items.summary: Fusion for Energy, in collaboration with Ansaldo Nucleare, Westinghouse and Walter Tosto, has completed manufacturing Europe's final vacuum vessel sector for the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor at Cadarache in south-eastern France.

items.title: Timeline for Polish nuclear units slips in updated programme
items.summary: Poland's Council of Ministers has adopted an update to the country's nuclear power programme - a strategic document outlining the development of nuclear energy in Poland - with the first nuclear power plant now expected to start up in 2036 and the second one in 2040.
